newsitem.title: USA: CD Radio gets $50 mln shareholders commitment.
newsitem.headline: CD Radio gets $50 mln shareholders commitment.

text.p: CD Radio Inc said Friday it received commitments from certain holders of its five percent delayed convertible stock to buy about $50 million of a new class of convertible preferred stock.
The company said the holders can buy the stock for cash or in exchange for shares of the delayed convertible stock.
The new stock will be convertible into common stock at a price of $21 per share.
The new class of preferred stock would be subject to mandatory redemption by the company after 10 years and to optional redemption after 5 years.
